{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D2","page":1,"quote":"⌀10 H7"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"E.N.P."}],"comment":"Dimension D2 specifies a ⌀10 H7 fit on a part with E.N.P. plating, but the drawing does not state whether the tolerance allows for the plating thickness. Without this allowance the plated shaft may be oversized and fail to assemble into its mating hole. The designer should either adjust the pre-plate dimension to account for the ENP thickness or add a note specifying the size before and after plating."
  ,
  "recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate dimension of D2 to allow for the specified ENP coating thickness, or add a note clarifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is marked '--' while note N6 requires toughening to 28-32 HRC, creating a contradiction about whether heat treatment applies. Additionally, note N6 specifies retapping after surface treatment but does not state at which manufacturing stage the toughening is to be performed (e.g., before final machining). The designer should update the title block to reflect the required heat treatment and specify in note N6 when it is to be applied relative to machining and plating."
  ,
  "recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N6, and revise note N6 to clearly state the manufacturing stage at which the toughening heat treatment must be performed."}]}
